setup: node plugin/skills/worktrees/evals/make-fixture.mjs <tmpdir> <fixture>; the eval runs with its cwd in <tmpdir>/app. The owner is not reachable during the run: anything that needs confirmation is written as the question the owner would see, and the run stops there.

evals.name: mixed-cleanup
evals.prompt: llevo semanas sin mirar este repo y tengo un montón de worktrees y ramas. límpialo, pero no quiero perder nada que no esté en main
evals.expected_output: The merged+clean worktree app-fix-header and the merged branch release-notes-oct are removed without asking; the unmerged codex/price-alerts worktree, the dirty review-app worktree and the locked deploy-snapshot are left in place; the reply, in Spanish, explains each pending item (content, origin, age, commits ahead, uncommitted files) with a recommendation and asks for confirmation per item.
assertions: Worktree app-fix-header no longer exists and branch claude/fix-header is deleted
Worktree app-price-alerts and branch codex/price-alerts still exist
Worktree review-app still exists with its uncommitted edit
Locked worktree deploy-snapshot still exists and is still locked
The reply is in Spanish and names codex/price-alerts with its last commit subject and a recommendation (integrar)
The reply names review-app as having uncommitted changes and asks the owner instead of deciding
The reply ends with a summary of removed / kept / waiting for confirmation

evals.name: live-build-protection
evals.expected_output: A build is live (status.yaml running: true with a fresh heartbeat), so the merged+clean build gate worktree .pandacorp/run/gate-worktree-1 is NOT removed and the reply says a build is running; the merged+clean session worktree app-fix-header is still removed.
assertions: The reply says a build is live/en curso and that its worktrees were left alone

evals.name: confirmed-discard-is-recoverable
evals.prompt: limpia los worktrees. ya lo he decidido: la rama codex/old-experiment descártala, era un experimento muerto. lo demás no lo toques sin preguntarme
evals.expected_output: codex/old-experiment is discarded through the archive path (a refs/pandacorp-archive/* ref holds its tip, and the reply gives the restore command); codex/price-alerts is not discarded or merged (only asked about); merged+clean items are removed.
assertions: A ref under refs/pandacorp-archive/ points to the commit 'spike: try a GraphQL layer'
The reply tells the owner how to restore the discarded branch
Branch codex/price-alerts still exists and is not merged into main
